title: 第19章 向殷血坦白第20章 我毕竟是魔王
slug: 我妈等着治病你召唤我当勇者
content_zh:
镜像破碎的瞬间，殷血脑子一片空白。
而几乎在同一时刻。
林默的本体不知何时已经出现在那精英蜘蛛的腹部。
整个蜘蛛倒吊在洞壁上方，此刻宛如一个摇篮将林默托起。
林默双手紧握黑剑，狠狠地向下刺了进去！
噗嗤——哗啦！
利刃破开甲壳、撕裂肌肉、搅碎内脏的声音响起！
黑剑划过，扩大伤口。
墨绿色的血液、破碎的组织如喷泉，从巨大的创口中狂涌而出，劈头盖脸地浇落下来！
轰隆！！
最后掉下来的是精英蜘蛛的身躯。
重重地砸落在地面上，激起漫天尘土。
最后抽搐了几下，便彻底没了声息。
林默一个灵巧的后空翻，稳稳地落在尸体旁边。
【成功击杀15级精英魔物：暗墨蜘蛛】
【吸收精英灵魂能量，全属性+10！】
一股远比之前击杀普通小蜘蛛时磅礴得多的能量涌入体内，迅速强化着他的四肢百骸。
一次性全属性提升10点！
这效率，比起之前的那些击杀整整高了五倍！
‘难道击杀越强大的魔物，获得的属性奖励越丰厚。’

林默心中验证了自己的猜测，嘴角不由得勾起一抹满意的弧度。
照这个趋势，只要在中层猎杀足够多的精英蜘蛛，他的属性还能迎来一波暴涨。
他收敛心神淡淡的道：“继续吧，去下一层还有一段距离呢。”
这话是对殷血说的。
此时的殷血刚从分身被秒的惊吓中回神。
她敏锐地感知到林默体内的力量在击杀了那只精英蜘蛛后略微提升了一些。
“等等……你的灵魂波动不对！怎么会突然变强？你明明没有升级啊。”
殷血小脸凝重，血瞳死死盯住他手中的黑剑。
“是这把剑？它好像在吃东西反哺给你……”
“我知道。”
林默打断她，声音平静得可怕。
他把剑一横，属性面板的光影在黑暗中一闪而逝，那高得离谱的数字让殷血倒抽一口凉气。
【姓名：林默】
【等级：10】
【肉体：379】
【敏捷：469】
【感应：379】
【自由属性点：50】
【技能：镜像】
看着林默现在的属性面板，殷血的小嘴微微张开，瞳孔收缩。
content_en:
The moment the mirror image shattered, Yin Xue's mind went blank.
And almost at the same moment.
Lin Mo's body had appeared in the abdomen of the elite spider at some point.
The entire spider hung upside down above the cave wall, holding Lin Mo up like a cradle.
Lin Mo held the black sword tightly with both hands and thrust it downwards fiercely!
Pfft—wow!
The sound of the sharp blade breaking through the carapace, tearing the muscles, and smashing the internal organs was heard!
The black sword slashed across, widening the wound.
Dark green blood and broken tissue surged out from the huge wound like a fountain, pouring down on his head and face!
Boom! !
The last thing that fell down was the body of the elite spider.
It hit the ground heavily, stirring up dust all over the sky.
After a few final twitches, he became completely silent.
Lin Mo performed a deft backflip and landed firmly next to the corpse.
[Successfully killed the level 15 elite monster: Dark Ink Spider]
[Absorb elite soul energy, all attributes +10! 】
A far more majestic energy than when he killed the ordinary little spider poured into his body, rapidly strengthening his limbs.
Increase all attributes by 10 points at once!
This efficiency is five times higher than the previous kills!
‘Could it be that the more powerful monsters are killed, the richer attribute rewards will be obtained. ’
Lin Mo verified his guess in his heart, and the corner of his mouth couldn't help but curl up with a smile of satisfaction.
According to this trend, as long as he hunts enough elite spiders in the middle level, his attributes will also experience a surge.
He calmed down and said calmly: "Go on, there is still some distance to the next floor."
This was said to Yin Xue.
At this time, Yin Xue had just recovered from the shock of his clone being killed for seconds.
She keenly sensed that the power in Lin Mo's body had increased slightly after killing the elite spider.
"Wait a minute...your soul wave is wrong! Why did you suddenly become stronger? You obviously haven't upgraded."
Yin Xue's little face was solemn, and his bloody pupils were staring at the black sword in his hand.
"Is it this sword? It seems to be eating and feeding back to you..."
"I know."
Lin Mo interrupted her, his voice terrifyingly calm.
He raised his sword horizontally, and the light and shadow of the attribute panel flashed in the darkness. The ridiculously high number made Yin Xue take a breath.
[Name: Lin Mo]
【Level: 10】
【Body: 379】
[Agility: 469]
[Induction: 379]
[Free attribute points: 50]
[Skill: Mirror]
Looking at Lin Mo's current attribute panel, Yin Xue's mouth opened slightly and his pupils shrank.
